id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying the unlistable api keys table

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies Clerk connector behavior: distinguishes a known 400 rejection on the api_keys endpoint from other 400s, preventing unnecessary account-wide or endpoint-wide failures. This could help warehouse ingestion reliability and reduce false-positive account limitations.
review.reason: Adds a Clerk-specific 400 error to the non-retryable error set, scoped to the api_keys endpoint, and adds a test asserting that 400s on other Clerk endpoints are not treated as this limitation.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of false-positive account limitations caused by this specific 400 error, which is not independently verified. The score is conservative, treating this as a maintenance and correctness improvement rather than a systemic capability expansion.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No tier assigned.
